items.promptText: Heavy rotary science fiction cannon firing one single short shot: sharp mechanical bolt clack and tight low percussive report, dry close perspective, quick tail. No burst, no voices, no music.
Industrial pneumatic nail launcher firing once: compressed air snap, heavy metal piston thunk and short sharp metallic zip. Isolated dry close sound, immediate onset, no music.
Science fiction pressure launcher firing once: deep sealed pressure vessel thump, compressed liquid gurgle and brief air hiss. Close isolated mechanical sound, immediate onset, no music.

Science fiction precision energy lance firing once: crisp electrical discharge crack followed by a thin high resonant metallic singing tail. Physical capacitor and arc character, no cartoon pew, no music.
Massive alien containment emitter firing once: immediate sub bass pressure impact, resonating steel chamber and strange descending electrical resonance dissolving into air. No voice or music.
Small fictional insectoid creature making a short rasping chitter and dry mandible clicks. Natural organic foley, close isolated perspective, no words, no human voice, no music.
Large fictional stone-armored creature making one deep chesty exhalation and rumbling growl, with subtle rocky grinding texture. Close isolated, no words, no human voice, no music.
Small fictional ethereal creature making a breathy airy whistle with soft crystalline overtones, rises then falls, delicate unusual animal call. Isolated, no words, no music.
Fictional alien creature makes a low resonant hollow croak with several close harmonic tones and a papery rattle. Ancient and otherworldly animal call, no words, no human speech, no music.
Enormous fictional reptilian creature gives a powerful low rumbling animal call with rough throat vibration and a short exhale. Naturalistic designed creature foley, isolated, no words or music.
Cinematic industrial pressure explosion: immediate sharp crack with a deep bass thump, brief scattering metal debris and airy dusty tail. One isolated event, no voices or music.
A precision mechanical tool trigger clicks once against an empty chamber. Small dry metal click and spring reset, extremely short isolated close sound, no music.
Small futuristic equipment latch locking securely: soft metal click followed by a clean very brief two-tone electronic confirmation chime. Understated realistic interface foley, isolated, no music.
Compact futuristic medical injector: quiet latch click, tiny pressurized hiss and soft electronic confirmation. Close isolated foley, restrained, no voice or music.
Electronic access card accepted by secure industrial reader: small tap then two delicate rising glassy tones with a quiet latch click. Restrained realistic game interface, no music.
Small futuristic power module engaging: short rising electric coil resonance, clean click and soft low pulsing hum tail. Isolated, sophisticated industrial foley, no music.
Heavy impact against padded protective body armor: muffled solid fabric thump with a brief rattle of hard plates. Single close hit, no human voice, no music.

Massive alien energy barrier powering down: descending electrical resonance and cracking crystalline static, finishing with a low bass pressure release. One isolated science fiction device sound, no music.
A close muffled heartbeat double thump, deep soft physical low frequency pulse, quiet background, one heartbeat pair, no music or other sounds.

A short cinematic science fiction completion sound: warm resonant metallic chime followed by three gentle rising harmonic tones, calm resolved tail. A single subtle game interface sting, no beat or voice.
A short cinematic science fiction shutdown sound: subdued low descending metallic tones with a soft relay click and a fading dark resonance. A single game interface cue, no voice or beat.
